zh: 不管左右怎样交替，只要确定总共从左边取 l 件、从右边取 r=n−l 件，左边取走的一定是前 l 件，右边取走的一定是后 r 件，基础费用也就完全确定了。
剩下的只是连续同侧取的额外费用：r 次右取最多把 l 次左取隔成 r+1 段，所以左侧连续重复至少 l−r−1 次，右侧对称至少 r−l−1 次；尽量左右交替、把多出来的都放在同一侧的末尾，就能同时达到这两个下界。
先求总重量；枚举 l 从 0 到 n，维护前 l 件的重量和 prefix，费用 = prefix×X + (总重 − prefix)×Y + max(0, l−r−1)×El + max(0, r−l−1)×Er，取最小值输出。结果可能超过 64 位，需要 128 位或大整数。
en: Whatever the order of left and right takes, once you fix that l bags come from the left and r=n−l from the right, the left takes are exactly the first l bags and the right takes are exactly the last r, so the base cost is fully determined.

What remains is the extra cost for consecutive same-side takes: r right takes split the l left takes into at most r+1 groups, so there are at least l−r−1 left repeats, and symmetrically at least r−l−1 right repeats; alternating as much as possible and putting the surplus at the end on one side reaches both bounds at once.

Compute the total weight; enumerate l from 0 to n while keeping the weight sum of the first l bags, with cost = prefix×X + (total − prefix)×Y + max(0, l−r−1)×El + max(0, r−l−1)×Er, and print the minimum. The result can exceed 64 bits, so use 128-bit or big integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate the final number of left takes l and right takes r=n−l. The base cost is uniquely determined by the first l items and the last r items, and the minimum numbers of consecutive left/right repeats are max(0,l−r−1) and max(0,r−l−1) respectively. Accumulate prefix sums and enumerate to find the minimum.

## Proof of correctness

With the counts fixed, whatever the interleaving, the left side takes exactly the first l items and the right side exactly the last r items. r right takes can separate l left takes into at most r+1 groups, so there are at least l−r−1 left repeats, and the right side is symmetric; alternating as much as possible and attaching the surplus takes at the end on the same side reaches both lower bounds at once. Extra costs are non-negative, so this construction is optimal. Enumerating every l covers all plans.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1) excluding the input; use arbitrary-precision integers.
